description: Create a clockin employee (POST /employees). Required: first_name, last_name, email. Optional: personnel_number, pin, department_name, costcenter, position, hourly_wage, device_ids, app_language, color, gender.

app_language.description: App language, e.g. de or en

device_ids.description: IDs of clockin devices/terminals the employee may use

pin_change_required.description: Employee must change the PIN at next login
